name: Acoustic picket node (representative)
description: REPRESENTATIVE acoustic picket node, not a named product. Cheap omnidirectional microphone node for a forward picket line. Ranges are planning figures for an engine-noise target; small electric quadcopters are detected at far shorter ranges.

rangeAccuracyM.note: A single acoustic node measures bearing at best, not range; not established by the public record.

azimuthAccuracyDeg.note: Representative omnidirectional microphone node: presence-and-alarm only, no bearing; localisation comes from crossing nodes.

elevationAccuracyDeg.note: No elevation measurement is published for this acoustic node; not established by the public record.

noiseFloorDb.note: Planning factor: the detection threshold implied by this record's own refAcousticDb (95 dB at 1 m) and detectRangeM (4000 m) under spherical spreading, 95 - 20 log10(4000) = 23 dB re 20 µPa, so the range the record already carries is reproduced. Below the broadband rural ambient (30 to 35 dBA daytime calm; Passmore, engrxiv preprint) because tonal drone harmonics are detected in narrow bins; a broadband single-microphone test needed SNR ≥ 3 dB over 32 to 37 dB ambient (PMC12656299). No vendor publishes a threshold.
